replication.target_description: Hypothesis to replicate and bet on: Participants exposed to inequality compared to a control are more likely to rate structural factors as more important in “getting ahead”. To evaluate this hypothesis, the authors perform a regression analysis (β = 0.353, SE = 0.076, p < 0.001, root-mean- squared error (RMSE) = 0.828 for structural factors); p. 9594. We randomly picked the structural factors result.

n.sample_role: participants in focal analysis after exclusions
n.exclusions: Since the experiment was expected to take on average 10 minutes, we had a show-up fee of $1.25. One participant was excluded for not completing all questions about perceptions of opportunity. One additional participant was excluded for not completing the question about partisan identification. Two more participants were excluded for not completing the question about ethnicity. Twenty-eight additional participants were excluded for failing an attention check.
